brief:
Gaza's government media office announced an emergency evacuation plan led by the Ministry of Public Works and Housing, coordinated with government ministries and institutions alongside international and UN organizations operating in the territory. The initiative aims to remove and evacuate cracked buildings at risk of collapse.

The plan represents a coordinated response involving both Palestinian Authority agencies and international partners working in Gaza to address infrastructure dangers across the enclave.

title: Gaza launches emergency plan to evacuate crumbling buildings
